prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one polished GitHub repository cover image, wide 2:1 landscape, ideally 1536 by 768. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the existing portfolio series' pearl-grey/icy-blue studio background, subtle cyan light ribbons, large clear ink-navy sans-serif title on the left, short legible Chinese subtitle underneath, tangible editorial illustration on the right. Do not copy its boxer, pose overlay or wording. Spacious and clean, refined soft lighting, recognizable subject, no watermark, no badges, no decorative metadata. Text safely inside generous margins, readable as a GitHub thumbnail.
Subject: a generic Chinese handbook and template toolkit that helps nontechnical product managers use AI coding tools to progress from a product idea through requirements, development, testing and deployment. This is a collection of manuals, rules, templates and verification scripts, NOT a finished end-user app or a one-click publishing service.
Right-side visual: three beautifully made substantial white-and-pale-blue technical handbooks, a slim laptop showing a simple nonverbal wireframe, a few tasteful paper checklists with checkmarks, and a small abstract cloud deployment icon. Arrange them as a premium practical starter kit photographed on a pearl studio table. A soft subtle path connects a sketch sheet, the laptop and the cloud symbol. Deep ink-navy book typography and restrained sage/cyan accents. No fake software screenshot, no actual code, no company names, no private repository names, no pricing, no claim of guaranteed or instant success.
Exact large text on left:
"From Idea"
"to Launch"
"AI 产品开发与上线手册"
Only these three short Chinese book labels may also appear, once each on the three books:
"开发"
"前端"
"部署"
The left title is the dominant typography; illustrations feel precise, calm and useful.
note: 手册、电脑与云部署图标是通用概念插画，不是已经上线的产品截图。
